menu.title: LeAccess settings
menu.restart: Takes effect after restarting the game.
menu.edit_in_file: This one is edited in LeAccess.cfg; Triangle restores the default.
menu.option.master_volume.details: Volume of every mod sound: radar, objects, enemies, NPCs, beacon and sonar. Speech is not affected.
menu.option.radar_enabled.details: Directional knocks and breaths when the way ahead, behind or to a side changes between open and blocked.
menu.option.radar_unexplored_mark.detail: The radar marks open directions that lead to ground you have not explored.
menu.option.radar_open_depth.details: How far a direction must be clear, in body widths, for the radar to call it open.
menu.option.radar_buffer.details: Audio buffer of the radar. Lower reacts sooner; raise it if the radar crackles.
menu.option.sonar_continuous.details: The older continuous wall tones, played alongside the radar.
menu.option.world_enabled.details: Sounds for loot, gold, chests, the stash, shrines, portals, waypoints and exits near you.
menu.option.world_volume.details: Volume of every object sound; each sound also has its own volume in Sounds.
menu.option.world_loops.details: Objects sound as continuous loops, several at once. Off plays one short repeated cue per kind, and potions and tomes go silent.
menu.option.world_loop_range.details: How far objects sound, quieter when far; objects on screen sound beyond it. Each kind can have its own distance in Sound distances. Zero limits them to the game's own range.
menu.option.enemies_enabled.details: Short directional growls for the nearest enemies in sight, faster when closer.
menu.option.enemies_bosses.details: The nearest boss or miniboss has its own deep swoop; off, bosses growl like other enemies.
menu.option.enemies_boss_volume.details: Volume of the boss sound, on top of the enemy volume.
menu.option.enemies_elites.details: Elite enemies have their own sound.
menu.option.enemies_elite_volume.details: Volume of the elite sound, on top of the enemy volume.
menu.option.enemies_ordinary_volume.deta: Volume of the ordinary enemy sound, on top of the enemy volume.
menu.option.npcs_enabled.details: Directional wooden taps for the nearest NPC you can talk to.
menu.option.npcs_names.details: Say the nearest NPC's name when you approach or it changes.
menu.option.npcs_range.details: How far NPCs are heard, as a multiple of each NPC's own interaction range.
menu.option.exploration_enabled.details: The scanner of places, quest markers, NPCs, objects and enemies, and the beacon.
menu.option.exploration_seen_range.detai: A place is listed once you have been this close to it with nothing in between.
menu.option.exploration_room_sounds.deta: A loop at the nearest room you have not entered and a cue when you first enter one.
menu.option.exploration_discoveries.deta: Say it with a sound when an exit, a waypoint or the stash is first seen.
menu.option.exploration_scanner.details: The right stick drives the scanner while the mod button is held.
menu.option.exploration_modifier_menu.de: Hold the mod button for the scanner, the beacon and the status readouts. The game's buttons pause while it is held.
menu.option.exploration_left_stick.detai: On pads other than PlayStation, L3 is the mod button instead of Back or View; the overlay map on L3 is off in gameplay.
menu.option.beacon_volume.details: Volume of the beacon pings and confirmations.
menu.option.beacon_explore_radius.detail: Ground this close to you, with nothing in between, counts as explored; the beacon routes only through explored ground.
menu.option.beacon_town.details: In towns the beacon routes to any NPC or the stash without walking there first.
menu.option.beacon_buffer.details: Audio buffer of the beacon. Raise it if the pings crackle.
menu.option.landmarks_names.details: Read signposts and zone or dungeon destinations as you come near.
menu.option.map_sections_announce.detail: Say structures at your feet, nearby scenery, and map areas or rooms as you reach them.
menu.option.map_sections_describe.detail: After a zone's name, briefly list the kinds of landmarks in it.
menu.option.map_sections_surfaces.detail: Say when the ground under you changes, such as wood, snow or water.
menu.option.combat_boss_life.details: Say a boss's remaining life as it falls.
menu.option.combat_elite_life.details: Say an elite enemy's remaining life as it falls.
menu.option.combat_nearest.details: Say the nearest living enemy within skill range, even before it attacks.
menu.option.combat_interval.details: Minimum time between nearest enemy announcements.
menu.option.combat_poll.details: Time between checks for the nearest enemy.
menu.option.combat_format.details: The spoken message for the nearest enemy, with the enemy's name in it.
menu.option.vitals_automatic.details: Master switch: say life and mana when they cross a band of percent, falling or recovering. The two options below choose which of them speak.
menu.option.vitals_potions.details: Say potion charges when one is used or picked up. The readout always includes them.
menu.option.vitals_gold.details: Say the gold you pick up.
menu.option.vitals_report_key.details: Keyboard key that reads life, mana, level and experience, potions and effects.
menu.option.vitals_controller_view: Life and mana on the pad
menu.option.vitals_controller_view.detai: The mod button plus Square reads life, mana, level and experience, potions and effects. Off leaves that button unread.
menu.option.quests_automatic.details: Say new quests, changed objectives and completed quests.
menu.option.quests_interval.details: Minimum time between quest updates; changes in between merge into the latest.
menu.option.progression_changes.details: Say a new level, new passive points and skills that can level up. The readout always works.
menu.option.dialogue_npc_lines.details: Speak what NPCs say in conversations, barks and cinematics. Turn it off if you hear the game's voices; lines without a voice are silenced too. Responses are always spoken.
menu.option.menus_positions.details: Say positions such as 3 of 8 in lists and grids.
menu.option.tooltips_keywords.details: Skill and passive details include the explanations of their status effects and keywords.
menu.option.character_sheet_summary.deta: Read attributes, resistances and defences when the character sheet opens.
menu.option.language.details: Language of the mod's speech. Automatic follows the game's text language.
menu.option.mod_menu_controller.details: L1 while Create, L3 or the mod button is held opens and closes this menu.
menu.option.mod_menu_key.details: This key together with Ctrl opens and closes this menu.
menu.option.diagnostics_controller_log.d: Write each controller press and the game action behind it to the log, for bug reports.
sound.RadarOpen.details: A soft breath from the side where the way is open; it rises in pitch ahead and falls behind.
sound.RadarBlocked.details: A short low knock from the side where a wall or edge blocks the way.
sound.RadarUnexplored.details: An open-ground breath that ends in two quick pips: that opening leads to a place you have not explored.
sound.EnemyBoss.details: A deep falling swoop from the nearest boss or miniboss in sight; it repeats faster as the boss gets closer.
sound.EnemyElite.details: A rising swell from the nearest rare or champion enemy in sight; it repeats faster as it gets closer.
sound.EnemyOrdinary.details: A short low growl from each of the nearest ordinary enemies in sight; it repeats faster as they get closer.
sound.NpcTap.details: A soft tap from a character you can talk to, placed in that character's direction.
sound.Gold.details: A coin pile on the ground nearby; it loops while the gold is in range.
sound.Equipment.details: A normal (white) equipment or idol item on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.MagicEquipment.details: A magic (blue) item on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.RareEquipment.details: A rare or exalted item on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.LegendaryEquipment.details: A unique, set or legendary item on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.Potion.details: A potion on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.Tome.details: An experience or favor tome on the ground, or a note or lore record you can read.
sound.Rune.details: A rune on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.Glyph.details: A glyph on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.AffixShard.details: An affix shard on the ground; it loops while in range.
sound.QuestItem.details: Keys, lenses, woven echoes and other quest or crafting materials on the ground.
sound.Chest.details: A chest or cache you can open; it loops while it is nearby.
sound.Stash.details: Your stash, where you store items; it loops while it is nearby and fades with distance.
sound.Portal.details: A portal, waypoint or time rift you can use; it loops while it is nearby and fades with distance.
sound.ZoneExit.details: A way into another zone or dungeon; walk to it to leave this area.
sound.Shrine.details: A shrine you can activate for a blessing; it loops while it is nearby.
sound.Nemesis.details: An altar that starts a Nemesis encounter; it loops while it is nearby.
sound.UnexploredRoom.details: A loop from the nearest minimap room you have not entered yet; it fades as you move away.
sound.RoomEntered.details: A short cue when you step into a room for the first time.
sound.Discovery.details: A chime when the radar logs a new exit, waypoint or stash for the first time.
sound.BeaconPing.details: A soft blip repeated while guidance leads you to a target; it sounds from the direction to walk.
sound.BeaconLocked.details: Two rising notes when guidance locks onto a target.
sound.BeaconCleared.details: Two falling notes when guidance is cancelled or its route is lost.
sound.BeaconArrived.details: Three rising notes when you reach the guided target.
sound.BeaconClick.details: A tiny tick when the exploration scanner menu opens.
sound.SonarAhead.details: A steady high tone while a wall is close ahead; only with the continuous wall sonar on.
sound.SonarBehind.details: A steady low tone while a wall is close behind; only with the continuous wall sonar on.
sound.SonarSides.details: A steady mid tone in the left or right ear while a wall is close on that side; only with the continuous wall sonar on.
menu.sound_hint: Cross plays it; left and right change its volume.
menu.distance_hint: Cross plays it; left and right change how far it carries. Zero follows the object distance.
menu.option.sonar_volume.details: Volume of the continuous wall tones.
menu.option.vitals_life.details: Say life when it crosses a band. The readout always includes it.
menu.option.vitals_life_step.details: How much life must change since the last announcement before a band is said again. Zero says every band; 10 percent life and below always speaks.
menu.option.vitals_mana.details: Say mana when it crosses a band. The readout always includes it.
menu.option.vitals_mana_step.details: How much mana must change since the last announcement before a band is said again. Higher means fewer mana announcements; empty mana always speaks.
menu.option.landmarks_shrine_effects.det: After you use a shrine, say its name and the effect it grants.
